label: Counting Z shapes
subgoals: Measure the column and row offsets between the pins
Count interior columns for HVH shapes and interior rows for VHV shapes
Exclude jogs at the pin columns or rows, which are L shapes

label: All pattern candidates
subgoals: Count the two L shapes for pins that differ in both coordinates
Add the Z shapes to get the full candidate count
Price each candidate by the edges it crosses

label: What patterns miss
subgoals: Count monotone routes as lattice paths
Subtract the L and Z patterns
Escalate from patterns to monotonic and maze routing
